references.text: Joshua, son of Nun, is mentioned here as one of the two spies who gave a positive report about the land of Canaan.
Moses gave Hosea, son of Nun, the name Joshua. This verse explains the name change from Hosea to Joshua.
Joshua is first mentioned as Moses' servant and military leader in the battle against Amalek.
Joshua, son of Nun, is described as Moses' young servant who remained at the tent meeting.
Joshua, son of Nun, is appointed as Moses' successor and tasked with leading the Israelites into the promised land.
Joshua, son of Nun, takes over leadership after Moses' death and becomes the leader of Israel.
Joshua, son of Nun, is chosen by God as Moses' successor because the Spirit is in him.
Ephraim is mentioned as one of Joseph's sons who was adopted by Jacob and became the ancestor of one of the tribes of Israel.
